2026-08-04 12:22:53.004030 | controller |
2026-08-04 12:22:53.004034 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-08-04 12:22:53.004046 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-08-04 12:22:53.004050 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-08-04 12:22:53.004053 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-08-04 12:22:53.004057 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-08-04 12:22:53.004060 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-08-04 12:22:53.004064 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
